title: Repository catalog
description: Machine-readable catalog of the organization's repositories. Consumed by bootstrap, fleet scripts, and compliance tooling.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema file (relative or absolute).

schemaVersion.description: Catalog schema semver. Bump when field semantics change.

organization.description: GitHub organization login. The single source of truth for the org name across all fleet tooling.

displayName.description: Human-readable organization name for docs and headings. Defaults to organization when absent.

pagesBase.description: Base URL for GitHub Pages sites, no trailing slash (e.g. https://<org>.github.io). Optional — only set once a repo actually publishes Pages.

name.description: GitHub repository name (and sibling workspace folder).

displayName.description: Human-readable title for docs and catalog listings.

type.description: app = end-user runnable software; library = published/importable package; tool = org tooling (e.g. this repo); config = settings-only repo (e.g. .github); template = seed repo for new members.

description.description: Full blurb for docs and catalog listings.

shortDescription.description: Optional GitHub About blurb (≤350 chars). When omitted, sync-github-metadata uses description (truncated if needed).

deployedUrl.description: Live/published URL override (Pages site, npm/PyPI package page, demo, etc). Omit when there is no override; null means explicitly not deployed.

githubTopics.description: GitHub topics to apply via sync-github-metadata. Kebab-case only.

status.description: active = maintained and CI-checked by fleet-health; draft/wip = in catalog but not yet shipped; archived = retained history; template = seed repo.
